chapter.verse: Pasian' min leh thuhilhna a kigendai loh nadingin sila hihna tawh hakkol nuai-a omte khempeuh in a tote uh nakpi thupibawl ding kilawm ci-in ngaihsun uh hen.

Thu-um to a nei silate in sanggam khat hihna bulphuhin a tote uh thupibawl lo-in omkha kei uh hen. Tua sangsikin hoihtak a sepna uh tawh phattuamna a ngah ding pen thu-umte leh a it a ngaihte uh ahihna hangin a hoihzaw kanin a sepsak ding uh ahi hi. Hih thute hilhcian inla hanthawn in.
Mi khatpeuh in i Topa Jesu Khris' thugen a kilekkimte leh biakna lungsim tawh kituak thu tawh a kilehngat thuhilhna a tuam khat hong hilhcian-a leh

amah pen bangmah thei lo pi-a kiphasak pong ahi hi. Thu a maanzaw kituhna leh kam tungnung kituhna a khengvalin a uuk hi a, tuate in hazatna, kitotna, mindaisakna leh a sialamin kimuanmawhna piangsak hi.
Tua banah biakna lungsim pen metna zawi khat bangin a ngaihsun, lungsim siahuai-in thumaan thutak a ngawlkha mite' kikal ah zong kingawhngatna piangsak den lai hi.
Tu-in lungkimna tawh a tonkhawm biakna lungsim pen metna lianpi himah hi.
A hang pen leitung ah i tunpih bangmah om lo a, leitung panin zong i paikhiatpih theih bangmah om lo ding hi.
Himah taleh annek tuidawn leh nikten puansilh i neih nakleh hihte tawh i lungkim ding hi.
Ahi zongin a hau nuam mite ahihleh siatcipna leh supmangna ah mite a tumsuksak thei siatzolna sung, thangzak sung, leh a haivai a lauhuai cilesa lunggulhna nam tampite' sungah puk uh hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh sum deihluatna pen thusia namkim kipatna zungpi ahi hi. Hih bang lunggulhna hang mahin kimkhat upna pan pialkhia-in lunggimna tampi thuaklawh uh hi.
Himah taleh Pasian' mipa aw, nang na hihleh hih thute peel inla dikna thu, biakna lungsim, upna, itna, thuakzawhna, lungnemna cihte sulzuih in.
Upna thu ah galdo bangin hoihtak do in. Nang hong kisapkhiatna mun lah ahi, teci tampite' mai-ah pulakna hoihtak na neih thu zong ahi, tawntung nuntakna lenkip in.
Vekpi' tungah nuntakna a guan Pasian' mai leh Pontius Pilate' kianga teci a panna ah thupulakna hoihtak a nei Khris Jesu' mai-ah hih bangin kong vaikhak hi.
I Topa Jesu Khris hong kilatkik dongin hih thupiakna ninbaanglo dingin leh kawkbaanglo dingin kem in.
Pasian in ama' sehtuam hun khat ah Khris hong kilangsak ding a, amah pen phat dinga kilawm, khat bek ahi Mangpa Lianbel, kumpite' Kumpi leh topate' Topa,
amah bek in sihtheihlohna a nei, naihzawhloh khuavak sunga teeng, kuamah' muh ngeiloh leh muhtheihloh, ahi hi. Amah in pahtawina leh tawntung ukzawhna nei ta hen. Amen.

Tu khanghun sunga mihaute ahihleh a kisaktheihkhak loh nading uh ahi zongin, muanbit theih ahilo hauhnate sangin eite' nopsak nadingin na khempeuh a dimletin hong sik Pasian' tungah a lametna uh a ngakh nading uh ahi zongin, amaute genin hilh in.
Amaute pen thupha a bawl, nahoih sepna ah a tangzai, mi' tungah a cingh, hopnopna lungsim a nei, hiding uh hi.
Tua hileh mailam hun' ading khuambul kip a phut bangin amau' ading vanmanpha a khol uh hiding a, tua pen nuntakna taktak a letkip theih nading uh ahi hi.
Timothy aw, “thutheihna” ci-a a kivawhkhial, a biaknavailo thu kihaikupna leh thu lehpanna cihte pan kiheikhia inla, nang' tunga hong ki-ap thu mah kemcing in.
A hang pen mi kimkhat tua thutheihna a pom manun upna pan pialkhia uh hi. Note' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
